description: Kit for Crossfade, an AI ad agent that mixes one brief across 31 ad platforms like a DJ riding faders: dashboard icons, a 3D mixer hero, feature cards, a launch banner, a gold-record milestone story, a product intro film and an animated golden-hour DJ deck scene, plus a launch boombox, report / radar / brand-safety cards, a ROAS case-study banner, an on-air lower third, a 2.0 launch film and a night-shift desk scene.
idea: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
